summary: Iteration 18 — Validated the SmartNotes single-block inline-calc redesign on /crm and the NEW Dashboard 'Performance' analytics section. ALL PASS (backend 6/6, frontend 100%). SmartNotes: data-testid=client-notes-editor renders a single block with one <input> per line. Typed '10x100' on notes-line-0 → notes-line-result-0 shows '= 1\u202f000'. Enter created notes-line-1; '50+25' → '= 75'. Enter → notes-line-2; '200/4' → '= 50'. notes-total = '1\u202f125 €' (then 100\u202f575 € after the Backspace-merge test). A letters-only line ('main d oeuvre') correctly shows NO result badge. Cursor stability: typing 'Z' at position 3 of '10x100' produced exactly '10xZ100' (no jump). Backspace at start of a non-first line merges with previous line. Autosave (~800ms) persisted to backend; PATCH /api/clients/{id}/notes returned 200, GET confirmed; re-navigating to /quotes then back to /crm and reopening the same client showed all 3 lines intact. Notes restored to empty for Amy COUFFON and MEURET Steve (verified via API). Dashboard Analytics: data-testid=analytics-section renders after the quick-action Nouveau Devis/Facture buttons. kpi-conversion='17.9% — 5/28 devis signés', kpi-delay='0.4 j — entre envoi et signature', kpi-signed='6\u202f593,5 € — devis acceptés'. revenue-chart-card renders a recharts BarChart (avr=8\u202f450, mai=5\u202f440). top-clients-card lists top-client-0..4 with euro amounts + progress bar (SCOZZAFAVE 2\u202f970 €, POUX Christian 2\u202f280 €, Nathalie LARGILLET 1\u202f700 €, MASSICOT Anne marie 1\u202f540 €, Amy COUFFON 1\u202f500 €). Regression: desktop-nav-catalogue link present; stats grid, profile/relances/catalogue cards still load; CRM list (32 clients), search (crm-search-input), and sort (crm-sort-select) work. No console errors. No real emails sent.

critical_code_review_comments: SmartNotes uses useMemo over `value` to derive lines and a `caret` ref to restore cursor position after Enter/Backspace structural changes. The post-render useEffect (no dep array) runs on every render but only acts when caret.current is set — safe and effective.
evalExpression is sandboxed by a strict regex /^[\d+\-*/().,]+$/ before Function() — safe.
computeNotesTotal only renders when there are >1 computed lines — good UX choice (single-line case already shows the inline result).
AnalyticsSection: loading state initial = (cache.analytics === null) — cache primed from initial fetch avoids flash. ResponsiveContainer w/ fixed height=150 prevents layout shift. Good.

Minor (non-blocking): when there's no computed line, the line containing only letters still gets the empty-flex row with min-h-[30px] and a dashed border — visually OK but produces an extra dashed separator at the end if the user always ends with an empty line. Cosmetic.
GET /api/stats/analytics is unauthenticated like the rest of the app (PIN-only client-side). Consistent with current security model.
